'''Yaras''', commonly known as '''Yaracats''', were a short-haired natatorial feline [[Species/Legends|species]]. Yaras were highly adept swimmers, either hunting fish or lurking underwater to ambush their prey.<ref name="codex" />

==Biology and appearance==
Yaras' yellow eyes did not have pupils and their ears evolved to resemble fins, which formed a row along the spine starting from the head. All four limbs head five digits, with the fifth being distinctively offset. Yaras had sharp teeth and two long upward fangs<ref name="TOR" /> that grew substantially with Yara's age.<ref name="pets">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Yaracat pets sold by vendors on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

A few variations of Yara existed; these included fully white ''Snowdrift Yara'' with but the fins being pink, and ''Thermite Yara'' with yellow-orange back side of the body. Juveniles of all three known types of Yara (including the common blue one) were sold as pets.<ref name="pets" />

==History==
When a transport ship carrying the first settlers crash-landed on [[Makeb]], a breeding pair of pedigree yaras in the cargo hold managed to escape and quickly adapted to Makeb’s wilderness. Changes in Makeb’s climate have driven them onto land, where they have found sentients to be a perfectly acceptable meal. Centuries of running wild have made them a dangerous prospect as pets.<ref name="codex" />

Several Yaras were present on board of a [[research vessel]] ''[[Jannimak]]'' and survived its [[Crash of the Jannimak|crash]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. To accommodate the alien species, ship's automatic systems terraformed the area surrounding the [[Jannimak crash site|crash site]], and Yaras inhabited a zone designated by [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] as [[Sporefall]]. Scientists of the Institute, accompanied by various contractors, conducted research in the area, collecting spore-samples from infected Yaras.<ref name="jannimak">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Sample Collection: Yaracats|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>
